segments.sensitive: One reviewer with self-described super sensitive skin reports the product worked well and did not irritate or peel under makeup.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report their pimples looked calmer, less red, or reduced within one to three days of use, and that the patch is easy to wear under makeup; one reviewer found the dried product still visibly shiny and detectable under makeup and would not buy again.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly reduced redness or a less irritated-looking spot the morning after application, with no dissent noted on this point.
